save_model_card: save a model card with validation videos, prompts, and LoRA finetune metadata to a README.md file
export_videos_to_mp4: export video frames as numpy arrays or PIL images to mp4 files with specified fps
load_or_create_model_card: load an existing or create a new Hugging Face model card with training metadata and widgets
populate_model_card: populate a model card with tags like text-to-video, diffusers, lora, and template labels
generate_model_description: generate a markdown model description for a LoRA finetuned text-to-video model with gallery and download links
